mechanism: Diclofenac (NSAID) may increase atomoxetine levels via CYP2D6 inhibition and reduce renal clearance; NSAIDs also increase cardiovascular and bleeding risks, particularly concerning given atomoxetine's noradrenergic effects on blood pressure.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and bleeding signs; consider alternative analgesia (acetaminophen); if combined use necessary, use lowest NSAID dose for shortest duration and ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
